caption: The drawing depicts two books with ornate red covers, positioned on a plain, light beige background. The book on the left is lying flat with its spine facing left, displaying cream-colored pages and a cover decorated with a golden basket, red and pink flowers, green leaves, and additional gold detailing. The book on the right stands upright with its cover facing outward and slightly open, revealing cream-colored pages inside. Its cover design matches the one on the left, featuring the same gold basket, flowers, and leaves, along with gold bands and with four gold starburst-like decorations on the spine. Both books have a predominantly red color scheme with multicolor decorations and gold embellishments. The composition is simple, with the books separated by empty space and centered on the background.
title: Painted Tin Trinket Box
